name: io.github.carlobianchi89/epwtools
title: EPW.tools
description: EnergyPlus weather files (EPW, DDY, STAT) and design conditions for any site, OpenStudio-MCP ready.

tools.name: get_nearest_stations
tools.description:
Nearest weather stations to a point (name, WMO id, distance, years of record). Free, no key.

meteostat_hourly_end (also given as hourly_end) is the end date of the Meteostat station inventory, not the
station's last report: newer hours are read from NOAA GHCNh.

tools.name: get_design_conditions
tools.description:
Heating and cooling design conditions for any site, free, in one of two modes that are never mixed.

mode="ashrae_method": the ASHRAE Handbook Ch. 14 method replicated at the nearest ASHRAE station for the
chosen edition (2025, 2021, 2017, 2013, 2009, 2005); about 0.23 degC mean absolute difference from the published tables.
mode="enhanced": EPW.tools Enhanced, not the ASHRAE method: values at the site itself, cooling moved to the
coming decade (heating from the station record), with a tested 90 % range. The DDY file for Enhanced costs 1 credit through the web or the API.

tools.name: list_cmip6_models
tools.description:
The models available for future-climate morphing: `default` is what a request without a model gets (the
CMIP6 ensemble median, id "ensemble-median", of the models in `ensemble.models`); `models` are the global CMIP6
models (NASA NEX-GDDP, 25 km, 24 since 2026-11-23), each usable by name;
`regional` are CORDEX regional-model pairs usable as `model` ids, `CORDEX-<DOMAIN>:<GCM>_<RCM>`:
EURO-CORDEX EUR-11 (12.5 km, Europe) and the other CORDEX domains (NAM, CAM, SAM, AFR, MNA, WAS, EAS, SEA,
CAS, AUS, ARC, ANT; 25 or 50 km). Each is refused outside its domain: pass lat and lon and each entry says
whether it `covers` the point. A CORDEX pair follows the RCP scenarios: its `scenarios` are the SSP ids it
accepts (never ssp370) and `forcing` names the RCP run each one is served from; the file is named and
labelled by that RCP. Free.

tools.name: analyze_epw
tools.description:
Summary statistics of any public EPW by URL (OneBuilding, EnergyPlus, a shared file): location header,
dry-bulb mean/min/max, annual global horizontal irradiation, data range warnings. Free, no key. 10 MB max.

tools.name: generate_epw
tools.description:
Start an actual-year (AMY) EPW + DDY + STAT for any point, 1990 to last year. 1 credit; +2 with
urban_street_level (53 US cities: hourly street-level air temperature from citizen stations). station_id
(from get_nearest_stations) builds the year from that station instead of the nearest usable one. Returns a
job_id; poll with get_job_result.

tools.name: generate_tmy
tools.description:
Start a typical meteorological year from a chosen period (at least 5 years; 10-20 is usual). 1 credit.
tmy_method: "nrel" (Sandia method, default) or "onebuilding" (ISO 15927-4; paid). data_source: "hybrid"
(station weather + reanalysis sun, default), "merra2" or "meteostat". use_case: weight preset "default", "pv",
"daylighting", "ventilation", "hvac" or "csp". Left out, each takes the server default.

tools.name: generate_future_climate
tools.description:
Start a CMIP6-morphed future EPW (Belcher 2005). scenario: ssp126, ssp245, ssp370, ssp585; horizon: any
decade 2030-2100; model: leave empty for the default, the CMIP6 ensemble median (per month and variable, the
median change of the ten CMIP6 models; recommended), or one id from list_cmip6_models (a CORDEX model only inside its domain). A CORDEX model takes ssp126, ssp245 or ssp585 only and
the file is the RCP2.6, RCP4.5 or RCP8.5 run, labelled as that RCP; ssp370 is refused. solar_split: "scale"
(default, the baseline split kept) or a decomposition model for direct/diffuse: erbs, erbs_driesse,
orgill_hollands, boland, louche, disc, dirint, reindl, brl, engerer2, bright_engerer, paulescu_blaga, median
(constrained median of Erbs, Orgill-Hollands, Reindl, DISC). illuminance: "kept" (default) or "perez"
(Perez et al. 1990 from the morphed sun). spread_variant (ensemble median only): median (default), plus_sd,
minus_sd (median +/- one standard deviation of the models), p10, p90; humidity, sun, wind and rain follow the
temperature change as the models do. temp_shift_winter / temp_shift_summer: a sensitivity case (not a
prediction), the winter / summer temperature change moved by this multiple of the model spread (-2 to +2,
default 0). grid_method: box (default), idw4, nearest, bilinear, area, spline. 3 credits.

tools.name: generate_forecast
tools.description:
Start a forecast EPW for the next 1-15 days (operational sims, MPC, demand response). 1 credit; more than
7 days needs an account that has bought credits.

tools.name: get_job_result
tools.description:
Status of a job started by a generate_* tool; when complete, the download URLs. The links are valid for a
short time (see downloads_note); call this tool again for fresh ones.
